1.Name: boot
1.Note: Runs first: turns the cursor and userput off, reads the starting room from local0 and sets the game's starting variables (global/script_0001.scumm). MMUCS reads its top-level constant writes as a fresh game's values.

88.Name: dress-chicken
88.Note: start-script bak rec 88(actor, scale, kind): dresses the actor as a chicken facing 90 (costume 67, or 69 when kind is 1) or 270 (68 / 70) at random, ignoring the boxes, never z-clipped, at the scale given; then pecks and clucks in a loop (global/script_0088.scumm). Used by fortbase (local 2007, 2013) and quiksand (local 2008).

338.Name: volcano-erupts
338.Note: The eruption cutscene: lava reaches the hotel's barbecue (hotel-ex objects to state 0, the fire costume 305, the pot boiling if the cheese is in it), then the bloodmap; sets volcano-erupted (global/script_0338.scumm:4-128).

342.Name: take-pot-of-cheese
342.Note: Guybrush takes the pot of melted cheese: the hotel's pot object goes, the shipwreck's pot-o-cheese becomes usable, sets took-pot-of-cheese (global/script_0342.scumm:64-68).

14:2007.Name: setup-chickens
14:2007.Note: Puts chicken 5 (actor 18, dress-chicken scale 175) at 1065,365, then starts local 2013 for the rest of the flock; also turns the player when arriving from room 378 and starts script 94 when bit102 is set (rooms/014_fortbase/local_2007.scumm).

14:2013.Name: place-chicken-flock
14:2013.Note: Grows fortbase-chicken-flock-size by 2 (to 15 at most) and puts that many chickens (actors 19 up) at random spots out of 16, each with dress-chicken; spots 3-12 are skipped while script 141 runs (rooms/014_fortbase/local_2013.scumm).

21:2013.Name: setup-barbers
21:2013.Note: Sets up the barber shop's pirates on entry: the barber chair (actor 13), McMutton (3), Rottingham (2), Cutthroat Bill (4) and Van Helgen (5), each by whether they've left yet (rooms/021_brbr-int/local_2013.scumm).

32:2008.Name: setup-actors
32:2008.Note: Puts actor 7 (costume 182) and the quicksand chicken (actor 18: dress-chicken, then costume 185 facing 270) in the room (rooms/032_quiksand/local_2008.scumm).

60:2001.Name: setup-barbecue
60:2001.Note: Once the volcano has erupted (volcano-erupted): the barbecue's fire (actor 15, costume 305) and its animation loop (local 2008); with the cheese melting in the pot (cheese-in-pot, not took-pot-of-cheese) the boiling pot (actor 14, costume 306) and its bubbling (local 2007) (rooms/060_hotel-ex/local_2001.scumm).

60:2002.Name: set-entry-states
60:2002.Note: On entry: the column and barbecue animation objects by volcano-erupted, and the pot's state: 0 once taken (took-pot-of-cheese), 4 or 2 with the cheese in it (cheese-in-pot) by volcano-erupted, else 5 or 1 (rooms/060_hotel-ex/local_2002.scumm).

60:2004.Name: cook-cheese
60:2004.Note: The cutscene where Guybrush puts the nacho cheese in the pot: pot states 2-4, and with the volcano erupted the boiling pot costume (306); sets cheese-in-pot at the end (rooms/060_hotel-ex/local_2004.scumm).

60:2006.Name: light-by-player
60:2006.Note: Loops: brightens palette slots 230-255 as the player nears 396,196 (box 15) or 569,196 (boxes 16, 18) (rooms/060_hotel-ex/local_2006.scumm).

60:2007.Name: bubble-pot
60:2007.Note: Loops: every 10-30 frames plays one of the boiling pot's animations 7-9 on actor 14, with one of sounds 610-614 when the player is near (rooms/060_hotel-ex/local_2007.scumm).

61:2012.Name: setup-goodsoup-and-xima
61:2012.Note: Goodsoup (actor 2) hungover at the bar (costume 308) until he's handed over the hangover cure (got-hangover-cure), then at 429,253 (309) with the glass and hand objects' states to match; and the fortune teller Xima (actor 3, costume 311) (rooms/061_hotelbar/local_2012.scumm).

71:2001.Name: setup-light-and-skull
71:2001.Note: Sets up actor 42 (costume 360) and, with the lantern on the ledge, the light animation object (state 1) and its loop (local 2016); then the skull (actor 5) by where it is (rooms/071_crakwall/local_2001.scumm).
